title: Golden Coconut Curry with Butternut Squash & Red Lentils
ingredients: 5cm piece of fresh root ginger, peeled and grated
1 red chilli, deseeded and finely chopped
steps: Put all ingredients except spinach into a large lidded casserole dish; stir; put lid on.
Cook in oven for 1½ hours, stirring halfway.
When done, stir in spinach and serve.
Slow cooker: cook 4 hours on high or 8 hours on low.
notes: Serve with rice or Quick & Easy Wholemeal Flatbreads (p.188) and fat-free Greek yogurt.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
